commonQuestions.q2Label: Question 2 – Financial Stability and Financial Position
commonQuestions.q2Help: The supplier must have a stable and sound financial position. The supplier must attach an extract from an established credit rating agency.
commonQuestions.q5Help: The supplier has a documented and third-party certified quality management system whose content and application correspond to a standard system such as ISO 9001 or an equivalent system. The supplier must attach documents showing that the requirement is fulfilled.
commonQuestions.q6Help: The supplier has a documented and third-party certified environmental management system whose content and application correspond to a standard system such as ISO 14001 or an equivalent system. The supplier must attach documents showing that the requirement is fulfilled.
commonQuestions.q7Help: The supplier has a documented and third-party certified management system for social responsibility whose content and application correspond to a standard system such as ISO 26000 or an equivalent system. The supplier must attach documents showing that the requirement is fulfilled.
commonQuestions.q8Label: Question 8 – Management System – Occupational Health and Safety
commonQuestions.q8Help: The supplier has a documented and third-party certified occupational health and safety management system whose content and application correspond to a standard system such as ISO 45001 or an equivalent system. The supplier must attach documents showing that the requirement is fulfilled.
commonQuestions.q9Help: The applying company may be excluded from participation in the dynamic purchasing system if it is subject to the exclusion grounds specified in Chapter 13, Sections 1, 2, and 3 of the Public Procurement Act (2016:1145). Certify that the applying company is not subject to any of the exclusion grounds specified in Chapter 13, Sections 1, 2, and 3 of the Public Procurement Act (2016:1145).
commonQuestions.q10Help: If the supplier does not have a collective agreement, specify the company's labor law conditions.
commonQuestions.q11Label: Question 11 – Sanctions Regarding Russia and Belarus
commonQuestions.q11Help: From April 9, 2022, it is prohibited to award and execute public contracts with companies and persons with connections to Russia and Belarus: Russian citizens or natural or legal persons, entities, or bodies established in Russia; legal persons, entities, or bodies that are more than 50 percent directly or indirectly owned by such entities; natural or legal persons, entities, or bodies acting for, or on behalf of, such entities.
commonQuestions.q12Help: To demonstrate that the tenderer has adequate technical capability and capacity for the requested delivery of 8000 laptops, tenderers must provide information about two (2) previous assignments. The reference assignments must have included deliveries of at least 8000 laptops to two different customers. Previous assignment must not be older than three (3) years, counted from final date for tender submission. The assignment must be concluded. The orders for the computers must be made through the supplier's webshop. A description of the assignments must be made in the attached Reference Appendix.
